# Experiment record template

Use a new unused Exx ID or extend an existing canonical experiment. Replace this title and add an exact ID heading only when this record becomes the canonical home; update existing references if moving a node.

- **Status / owner / date:** Proposed, running, completed, or superseded; unassigned unless known.
- **Question / hypothesis:** Distinguish expected outcomes from facts.
- **Related IDs / provenance:** Components, contracts, requirements, source evidence, and decision informed.
- **Method / comparison / review criteria:** State inputs, annotations, timing, and limitations; no invented thresholds.
- **Data handling / reproducibility:** Consent/retention, source references, dependency versions, replay isolation and clock where relevant.
- **Results / limitations:** Actual evidence only; “not run” until performed.
- **Decision implications / next questions:** Do not treat results alone as team acceptance.

Follow [evaluation boundaries](../../evaluation/README.md), update the [index](../README.md), and use [maintenance](../maintenance.md).
